clients.noConfig: This client has no configuration yet.

clients.paused: Client paused. Nothing is sent until you resume.

governance.title: Go-live and governance
governance.intro: Real sending needs all three keys on. Nothing on this page sends anything.
governance.keyClientsOff: No client is in live mode
governance.checklistIntro: Only you sign these off. Each sign-off asks for your authenticator code and, ideally, a link to the evidence (the solicitor's letter, the ICO certificate, and so on).
governance.countriesIntro: A country is only considered once its rules have been reviewed by your solicitor and you have enabled it. Enabling never sends anything by itself.
governance.enableHint: Prospects in this country can then pass the compliance check. Sending still needs the three keys.
governance.taxIntro: Invoices can't be issued until your accountant has reviewed the rule that applies. Record their review here.
governance.adequacyIntro: If the adequacy decision lapses, sending personal data between the UK and EU needs other safeguards.
governance.mfaFailed: That authenticator code didn't work. Check the code and try again.
governance.sourcesIntro: Paid lookups (contacts, email checks, AI) happen only when all three keys are on. Until then each one waits in the dry-run log.

crm.title: Your CRM
crm.intro: Each meeting we book for you can appear in your HubSpot: the company, the contact, and a deal that moves through your pipeline as the meeting is confirmed, attended or cancelled. If you move a deal to your "attended" stage, that counts as proof the meeting happened.
crm.safety: Nothing is written to your CRM until your account is switched to live. Until then, every update we would make is recorded in our dry-run log instead.
crm.counts: {synced} meeting(s) up to date, {waiting} waiting, {failed} need attention
crm.tokenHint: In HubSpot: Settings > Integrations > Private apps > Create. Give it read and write access to contacts, companies and deals, then paste its access token here. We store it encrypted and never show it again.
crm.pipelineHint: "default" for HubSpot's standard sales pipeline. Other pipelines show their id in Settings > Objects > Deals > Pipelines.
crm.stagesLegend: Which deal stage should each meeting status use?
crm.stagesHint: Use the stage ids from the same settings page. HubSpot's standard pipeline is filled in for you.
crm.saved: Connected. Meetings will appear in HubSpot once your account is live.
crm.disconnectReason: Why are you disconnecting? (at least 10 characters)
crm.disconnectedNotice: Disconnected. Nothing more will be written to your CRM.

tasks.title: Contact tasks
tasks.intro: Leads to reach by hand, never by automated email: decision-makers found on a public register with no email address, and prospects whose country rules allow other channels only. Names are hidden; showing one asks for a reason, and every view is logged.
tasks.reason: Why do you need to see this? (logged)
tasks.note: What did you do? (kept with the task)

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.intro: Every campaign starts as a pilot: at most 100 new people are emailed until you raise or remove the limit. Follow-ups to people already contacted continue.
campaigns.limitHint: Leave empty for no limit (full volume). Raise it only after the pilot thresholds are met: bounces under 3%, no complaints, replies coming in.
campaigns.pausedOk: Campaign paused. Its queued emails are held.
campaigns.created: Campaign created in draft. Start it once the client is active.
campaigns.started: Campaign started. It hunts on the next scheduled run.
campaigns.noActiveClients: No clients with a configuration yet.

landing.metaTitle: Qualified meetings from public buying signals
landing.metaDescription: PipelineOS finds UK companies showing a public reason to buy, writes to the right person, and books qualified meetings. You approve every email. You pay for meetings that happen.
landing.eyebrow: For UK IT managed service providers
landing.headline: Qualified meetings with buyers who have a reason to talk now.
landing.lede: PipelineOS watches public contract awards, hiring and company-register changes, writes to the right person with the reason in the first line, and books the meeting into your calendar. During the pilot you approve every email. You pay for qualified meetings that actually take place.
landing.ctaNoEmail: Pilot enquiries: contact the operator who gave you this link.

steps.d: A contract award, new roles in your area, a new director or a funding filing. Every lead starts from a fact you can check, with its source link.
The decision-maker from public registers and the company's own published channels. No scraped profiles, no bought lists.
Short, specific to the signal, in your voice. Checked against your rules, the law of the recipient's country and every suppression list, twice: when queued and again at send time.
Replies are read and answered with your agreed playbook; interested buyers get your calendar. You see the full evidence for every meeting.

pay: Only meetings that took place, with a buyer who meets the criteria you signed in your portal.
Attendance confirmed by your calendar, your CRM or you, never by us alone.
Every billed meeting shows its evidence chain, and you can dispute it within the agreed window.
Prices are agreed and signed before anything is billed.
pilot: 14 days, one campaign, at most 100 people contacted.
You approve every email before it is sent.
Sending starts slowly on warmed-up mailboxes and stops automatically if bounces or complaints rise.
One button stops all sending at once. Nothing is lost: it continues only when you agree.
landing.trustTitle: Built to be safe to say yes to
trust: One-click unsubscribe in every email, honoured everywhere at once.
Business contacts only, minimum data, with a clear notice of where we got it.
A full audit trail of every decision, email and meeting.
Your data stays separate from every other client's, enforced by the database itself.
landing.honest: PipelineOS is taking on its first pilot clients. We will publish results when they are measured, not before. Until then we can show you exactly how it works, on demo data, before you commit to anything.
landing.formIntro: Tell us who you are and we'll reply within two working days. We only use these details to answer you.
landing.fConsent: I agree that PipelineOS may contact me by email about a pilot. I can ask for my details to be deleted.
landing.fSent: Thank you. We'll be in touch within two working days.
landing.fError: That didn't go through. Please try again in a few minutes.

proof.title: Customer proof
proof.intro: Testimonials your clients wrote and agreed to share. Use each one only as its scope allows, and never next to numbers the client's own report doesn't show.
proof.empty: No testimonials yet. Ask a client after a good month; they add it in their portal.
proof.clientIntro: If PipelineOS has helped, a few words from you help other companies decide. You choose how you are named, and you can withdraw it here at any time.
proof.attribution: How to name you (e.g. Sam Carter, MD, Acme IT)
proof.thanks: Thank you. You can withdraw it below at any time.
proof.withdrawnOk: Withdrawn. It will not be shown again.
